subject: Bruce Arena says US Soccer 'don't have a clue' how to replace Pochettino
title: Arena: US Soccer has no plan for Pochettino

lines.vo: Pochettino leaves the US for Manchester United. Bruce Arena has opinions.

lines.vo: Arena says the federation is handling the search for a successor poorly.

lines.vo: His last game was a 2-0 win over Haiti, sending the US to the Nations League finals.

facts_used: Arena said the federation is handling the search for Pochettino's successor poorly (news id 56, espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50525211)
Pochettino left the USMNT for Manchester United after a 2-0 win over Haiti that sent the US through to the CONCACAF Nations League finals; 8-0 on aggregate (news id 56)
He left less than three months after signing a new US Soccer contract (news id 56)
U23 coach Steve Cherundolo will lead a December camp and a friendly against Jamaica (news id 56)
notes: Non-comic. Arena's 2025 opposition to hiring a foreign coach is deliberately left out; it is a nationality-based point. 'Don't have a clue' is paraphrased. Jokes rest on the documented short tenure after a new contract.
